shared_elements: figures shown in profile facing one direction
horizontal band of repeated motifs running across the top
division of the surface into stacked horizontal registers
justification: Both are stone reliefs organised into horizontal registers, with a band of repeated small motifs along the top edge and profile figures below, and both include small quadrupeds near the lower part of the field. Beyond that generic scheme they diverge sharply: A is a coarse, schematic, isolated animal-dominated pillar with irregular spacing, while B is a finely modelled, evenly spaced procession of robed human figures framed by neat rosette borders.
